purpose: Carousel topic ledger - Ram's rules 28/09/2026: (1) NO topic repeats for 6 MONTHS after posting, (2) subjects cover SIP, mutual funds, stocks, investing basics, (3) the FIRST carousel of each month uses a month-start theme (new month, salary day, fresh SIP), the LAST carousel of each month uses a month-end theme (review, checklist, SIP due verification).

rules.month_start: first carousel slot of the month - theme: new month / salary day / SIP reset
rules.month_end: last carousel slot of the month - theme: month-end review / SIP verification / tax dates
rules.bank_low_rule: when fewer than 5 unused bank topics remain, extend the bank with new SIP/mutual-fund/stock/investing topics before the next run
rules.caption_rule: carousel captions include a Save line (e.g. 'Save this before your next salary.') placed just before the engagement question; all other caption rules unchanged
